headline: Arsenal, Mikel Arteta open to Max Dowman loan move
description: Arsenal are "open" to allowing teen sensation Max Dowman to leave the club on loan if he does not play enough matches.

headline: Xabi Alonso says Chelsea were 'out of control' in Brentford loss
description: Xabi Alonso said his Chelsea team lost control against Brentford in their 3-0 defeat on Friday evening and agreed with Levi Colwill that his side were bullied in set pieces.

headline: How can erratic Chelsea find stability? For starters: Look to Brentford
description: Brentford's 3-0 thrashing of Chelsea served as a humbling reminder of what a well-run club can accomplish.

headline: Brentford 3-0 Chelsea: Premier League action as Bees sink Xabi Alonso's Blues - as it happened
description: Goals from Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago and Fábio Carvalho see Brentford beat Chelsea. Follow reaction with ESPN.

headline: High-flying Brentford hammer struggling Chelsea
description: Chelsea's winless run in the Premier League stretched to three matches as Brentford ran out deserved 3-0 winners at the Gtech Community Stadium.
